summary.description: Each Pareto line is computed within one fixed GPU count for the selected GPU family. Candidates include monolithic decode, PD split rows, PD+MTP rows, and PD+MTP+AF-hybrid rows when matching prefill/decode split counts exist.
summary.mtp_note: MTP rows are native C++ simulation outputs with MTP_on and mtp_stage enabled; no Python post-process latency-ratio model is applied.
summary.pp_note: PP is swept when --pp-values includes values beyond 1. PD rows cap prefill at 20% of the fixed total, rounded down to an 8-GPU multiple, with decode taking the remainder. Decode A/F split rows pin the F side to groq-lpx3.
summary.title: Rubin-Ultra DeepSeek-V4-Pro fixed-GPU strategy Pareto
